facts.text: White Cloud’s community library hosts a local history department that assists both residents and non‑residents with genealogy research for Newaygo County.
The city proudly serves as the county seat of Newaygo County, anchoring regional governance and services.
In 2018, a $13 million state‑of‑the‑art feed mill opened, positioning White Cloud as a leader in agricultural nutrition.
Every August, the Purple Heart Pow Wow brings families together in White Cloud, celebrating military heritage with music and dance.
White Cloud earned the title of “Trail Town” from the North Country Trail Association, highlighting its role in the national trail network.
The local history department requires a librarian or volunteer to be present for research, ensuring accurate and personalized assistance.
